summary.text: Tricia Farley-Bouvier is a Democratic state representative from the 2nd Berkshire District who has served since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Pittsfield native, she previously worked as the city's director of administration.

paragraphs.text: Tricia Farley-Bouvier was born and lives in Pittsfield, Massachusetts.
She earned a bachelor's degree in special and elementary education from Salve Regina University in 1986 and a master's degree in education from the University of Connecticut.
Her career experience includes working as the director of administration of the City of Pittsfield.
Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the Massachusetts House as beginning in 2011.
For 2025-2026 she chaired the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
